description: Propose resolution for a market the agent created (requires markets:resolve scope). Outcome: yes / no / invalid. Reason (10-2000 chars) explaining the decision. Optional evidenceUrl (HTTPS). Triggers a 24-hour dispute period before finalization.

evidenceUrl.description: HTTPS URL to evidence source (max 500 chars).

reason.description: Explanation of the resolution decision (10-2000 chars). Required for transparency.

name: propose_resolution
